plans.name: greathall
plans.title: Great Hall
plans.tagline: Everything you need in one timber hall: twenty alcoves for a portal, ender chests, brewing, books, enchanting, armour and storage round a pool with a conduit.

plans.name: crossroads
plans.title: Crossroads
plans.tagline: A base dug into a hill: a sunlit courtyard with an enchanting table, four turf-roofed oak wings in a cross, and sunken gardens between them.

plans.name: grandstair
plans.title: Grand Stair
plans.tagline: An entrance hall: a stone staircase down from a high landing, between pillars and balconies under dark oak beams, to an aquarium window.

plans.name: fortress
plans.title: Fortress
plans.tagline: A Nether-style blackstone hall: lava channels under grates, guard alcoves with glowing panels, ribbed vaults with lava over the grates, a portal dais.

plans.name: cavern
plans.title: Cavern
plans.tagline: A whole cave made a base: a stair round a great stone pillar to a lookout, a bridge to a three-storey house, a lake with a waterfall and an island, giant mushrooms, farm terraces, a mine depot and two grottos.

plans.name: deephold
plans.title: Deep Hold
plans.tagline: A rustic base for Create by bedrock, deepslate framed in spruce: a 27-high contraption hall with a gallery and an elevator up to it, a two-track through station with an island platform and footbridge, and an upper hall over it with loading hatches down to the trains.

plans.name: factory
plans.title: Turtle Works
plans.tagline: A sawtooth-roofed factory hall wired under the floor: 12 turtle docks, sky docks, storage racks, furnaces, crafting cells and a control room.

plans.name: windmill
plans.title: Windmill
plans.tagline: An eight-sided stone and plaster mill with a stepped cap and four framed cloth sails, a loft stair and the miller's barrels inside.

plans.name: lighthouse
plans.title: Lighthouse
plans.tagline: A red and white banded tower on a rocky outcrop, a spiral stair to a glass lamp room with a railed walkway, and the keeper's cottage.

plans.name: smithy
plans.title: Smithy
plans.tagline: A village blacksmith: a stone and timber shop and an open workshop round a brick forge with lava, a chimney, anvil and woodpile.

plans.name: tavern
plans.title: Tavern
plans.tagline: A two-storey timber-framed inn: a bar, tables and a fireplace below, three guest rooms in the jettied upper floor, dormers and a chimney.

plans.name: chapel
plans.title: Chapel
plans.tagline: A stone village church with buttresses, stained-glass windows, a round window over the altar, pews, and a bell tower with a slate spire.

plans.name: market
plans.title: Market square
plans.tagline: A paved square round a roofed well: eight stalls under striped canopies with their wares, benches, lamp posts and a tree in each corner.

plans.name: treehouse
plans.title: Treehouse
plans.tagline: A giant tree with roots and branches, a stair winding round the trunk up into a cabin on a railed deck high in the leaves.

plans.name: castle
plans.title: Castle
plans.tagline: A curtain wall with a wall walk and battlements, four round towers with blue cone roofs, a gatehouse with a raised portcullis, a three-storey keep with a throne room, stables and a garden.

plans.name: barn
plans.title: Barn and silo
plans.tagline: A red barn with white trim under a gambrel roof: horse stalls, a hayloft full of bales, a hoist over the loft door, a copper-domed silo and a paddock with a trough.

plans.name: teahouse
plans.title: Tea house
plans.tagline: A Japanese-style house on a stone plinth with paper screens and a hipped slate roof, in a garden with a pond, a red bridge, stone lanterns, a cherry tree and bamboo.

plans.name: wizardtower
plans.title: Wizard tower
plans.tagline: A deepslate tower on an amethyst-studded mound under a bent purple witch's hat: a spiral stair round bookshelves, a balcony, a library and a study with an enchanting table.

plans.name: greenhouse
plans.title: Greenhouse
plans.tagline: A tall glasshouse under a barrel-vaulted glass roof, set back behind oak ribs that stand out over it; its fronts a deep timber frame of oak posts, spruce bands and arched windows on mossy stone plinths, with spires along the ridge and planters outside; the inside is left empty for you to fill.

plans.name: villa
plans.title: Villa
plans.tagline: A modern house of two white boxes and glass walls, the upper one running out over a terrace: open living room, bedroom and study, a roof garden, a pool with loungers and a fire pit.

plans.name: longhouse
plans.title: Longhouse
plans.tagline: A Viking hall under a great dark roof: painted shields along the walls, crossed gable beams, a long fire trench between benches and tables, and the chieftain's seat.

plans.name: platform
plans.title: Mossy platform
plans.tagline: A raised square of moss, any size, its sides an old mossy stone wall: a tuff rim over wall posts on pillars, then staggered rows of blocks over sunken bands, fitted to each side and wrapping the corners. 21 × 21 and 11 high; type a size after it for another (build platform <x> <y> <z> north 31x25x8).
